Name: Alarm Lock PG21 Narrow Stile Surface Mounted Door Alarm
Natural: This Alarm Lock PG21 door alarms are for surface mounting on a door or door frame. It is generally used in applications such as emergency fire escape doors, nursing home stairwell doors, and rear restaurant and theater doors to restrict unauthorized egress. Many facilities have doors which are not used on a standard basis, but they are there for emergencies or certain purposes. Such doors are often found leading to an emergency fire escape, nursing home stairwells or rear restaurant and theater doors. An exit alarm on these doors will discourage their use when unauthorized and will notify authoritative personnel when misused.
